$description: Exo design tokens. The one source: scripts/build.mjs renders dist/.

0.$description: The page. Only backgrounds are Void black; everything on it is glass.

1.$description: A layer just above the page (hover on a plain surface).

2.$description: Placeholder under art, and solid controls.

4.$description: The one light hairline that sets a surface apart.

6.$description: A ring that is the control itself (radio dot, checkbox).

selected.$description: The current tab, row or segment.

track.$description: Off half of a switch, empty slider.

rim.$description: The one even line round glass.

clear.$description: No tint: the glass shows what is behind, toned.

scrim.$description: Dims the room behind a sheet.

panelOverlay.$description: Large glass is this overlay over a thicker blur.

muted.$description: Page only (7.7:1 on Void). Not on glass.

faint.$description: Page only, never for words you must read.

primaryHover.$description: White cannot brighten, so it steps down a shade.

onState.$description: Words on a good or bad fill.

worstArt.$description: Test backdrop: the brightest art glass has to hold words over. Not a colour the UI draws.

small.$description: Controls, capsules, the mini player: clear glass over a 10px blur, no shadow.

large.$description: Sheets, menus, popovers, notices: 20px blur, the overlay, a raised shadow.

pane.$description: A pane (a side panel) under its content.

plate.$description: Words over art: the art held down further.

raised.$description: Large glass only. Small glass casts no shadow.

words.$description: A tight shadow under words over bright art.

width.$description: One thin even line, the same 1px on all glass.

panel.$description: Floating panels, popovers, dialogs, featured art.

inset.$description: The window inset and the gap between floating things.

capsule.$description: A floating capsule in the top bar.

band.$description: The band the capsules float in.

row.$description: A row where space is tight.

settingsRow.$description: A settings row, with room for one line.

mono.$description: Geist Mono is not bundled yet (see DECISIONS.md).

read.$description: Reading text: chat message bodies, embed descriptions and the composer. 13 is for UI labels (owner decision, 2026-11-07).

semibold.$description: Geist ships static cuts here (300 to 700); titles use 600, not 650.

none.$description: No letter-spacing: lowercase stays as set.

quick.$description: A press letting go, a hover leaving, anything closing.

base.$description: Menus, popovers and glass appearing, a choice, a tab.

move.$description: A selection or knob travelling, a sheet settling.

flight.$description: Art flying to a new place.

settle.$description: Large surfaces settle on the spring in this time.

out.$description: What appears, fades or changes state.

spring.$description: Large surfaces only (card morph, page enter, sheet): damped at 0.85, settles in 260ms, overshoots at most 1%.

hover-lift.$description: A cover lifts 3px and takes a little light. A control only changes its fill (ink.hover).

page-enter.$description: A room or page: the old one fades out, the new one fades in and slides 12px on the spring.

card-morph.$description: A thing that changes size: FLIP, the old box inverted back to its place, then played to rest on the spring.

list-stagger.$description: A list arriving: a fade and 8px rise, 24ms apart; the eighth and later together.

sheet.$description: A sheet settles from the middle over a scrim. A popover is this motion at 0.96 on the base time, growing from its trigger. Closing is not specified upstream: mirrored at the quick time (DECISIONS.md).

toast.$description: A notice drops 8px into the stack and leaves by fading. Floating glass is there at once under reduced motion.

progress.$description: A bar: the fill eases out over 300ms; a sheen crosses it every 1.6s and a glide every 1.4s while Exo is focused.

stroke.$description: Tabler outline on its 24 grid: 1.25px at 16px.

compact.$description: Under this the Bar drops its gaps and tabs.

designWidth.$description: Layouts are drawn as on a 1080p screen (DESIGN.md › One layout on every screen).
